Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision
you reported in Conroe. Can you confirm you're comfortable continuing?
A: Yes, I'm fine to continue.
Q: Please describe where you were when the collision happened.
A: I was pulling out of a parking space near the front entrance of the shopping center. I had just put my car in reverse
and was checking my mirrors.
Q: What did you see before the impact?
A: I didn't see much at first. I think a vehicle was coming down the main drive toward the exit, but I was focused on
backing out. I felt the impact on the rear passenger side before I really registered the other car.
Q: How fast were you moving when it happened?
A: Very slowly, maybe walking speed. I don't think I'd been moving more than a few seconds.
Q: Did you hit your head or lose consciousness?
A: My head hit the side window. I didn't pass out, but I was dizzy and had a headache right after.
Q: Have you soguht medical care since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same afternoon. They said I have a concussion and told me to limit screen time and
rest for a while. I still get headaches and some light sensitivity.
Q: Did you give any statement to the other driver or the police at the scene?
A: I told the officer what I remembered, that I was backing out and felt the impact. I was pretty shaken, so I may not
have gotten every detail right.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add or correct?
A: Only that I want to make sure my medical bills and time off work are documented. I'm still recovering, so I'd
appreciate follow-up on that.
Q: Thank you. We'll be in touch with next steps and any documents we need from you.
A: Thank you.
</page>

  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
